title: REQ · buildEffects places all effects on the effects layer and a helper destroys them on shutdown
summary: destroyEffects tears down every handle and BootScene uses it
description: Context: BootScene SHUTDOWN handler loops handles with forEach. Desired: export destroyEffects(handles) from buildEffects.ts that destroys every handle and tolerates a throwing handle so the others are still destroyed; BootScene calls it. Why: Phaser effects created from content must be destroyed on shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Given handles where one destroy throws, when destroyEffects runs, then every other handle's destroy is still called
Given a scene with six non-transition effects, when buildEffects runs, then each createEffect call carries depth layerDepth('effects')
Given BootScene shutdown, when it fires, then destroyEffects is called with the created handles
